summary.text: Donald McFarlane is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 18 who has held the seat since December 4, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A risk manager by profession, he succeeded John Sellers (R) in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Donald McFarlane earned a high school diploma from Winchester College and a bachelor's degree from the Imperial College of Science and Technology.
His career experience includes working as a risk manager.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, McFarlane described himself as a father, husband and graduate electrical engineer trained in information security, risk management and incident and emergency management.
He said he spent a decade as a volunteer EMT and EMS chief and serves on the planning board and budget committee in the town of Orange, where he has lived since 2008.
McFarlane assumed office on December 4, 2024, succeeding John Sellers (R).
